desc:
Can You Run A Restaurant With 3 Friends?

Split the action with your friends: the more players in your restaurant, the more demanding customers will become. You can also choose to go solo and inflate the difficulty artificially if you are feeling hard-working.
Tips: You can create a save with password and share it to your friends, so this private server will only your friends who have the password can join in

🍔 Cook recipes and serve customers!
🪑 Build and decorate your restaurant!
🐮 Raise animals and farm crops!
🧑‍🍳 Hire staff to do the work for you!

💖Use Code to reward Special Gift!
💎Likes Code: 5KFEAST
👍 NEW CODE releases once the game gets 8000 LIKES!!!
Thanks for playing! 🩵
